verdict.rationale: Bolna documents its own post-call extraction feature. The API creates extraction categories (a name plus a model) and attaches them to an agent, and the Analytics tab configures webhooks, call summaries and extractions to push data from every call. However, the payload schema and the specific coverage of outcomes, entities and dispositions are not documented, and the legacy post-call extraction was removed in a migration. Missing for 10: documented extraction output schema (outcomes/entities/dispositions), webhook payload and delivery details, API retrieval of extracted fields, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from every call — outcomes, entities, dispositions — delivered via API or webhook after the call

citations.quote: POST /agent/{agent_id}/extraction-categories — create a category (name + model) and attach it to an agent
